package.scope: User-provided XENIOS_RECRUITER_AND_RESOURCE_HUB package; recursive regular PDFs, links excluded

downloads.censusRule: Fresh census of every regular case-insensitive *.pdf recursively under C:/Users/sboad/Downloads; do not traverse symlinks/junctions/reparse links; no other exclusions
downloads.mixedVerdictExplanation: Validator includes original basename policy; same content can have distinct filename verdicts

fullCensusReceipt.inventory: 1133 records containing ordinal, content SHA-256, byte size, verdict and reasons; no PDF filenames or content

historicalScope.relationship: Unrelated historical scope; neither count was reproduced or validated by this fresh explicit census

limitations: Counts are file occurrences; duplicate bytes can appear at several paths. Two content hashes receive different verdicts because original basenames differ.
Original basename was supplied only in memory to the unchanged validator. Declared MIME type was application/pdf; this was not an HTTP upload.
Refusal categories express the existing V1 intake/format policy, not a conclusion that a document is unsafe. Reasons overlap: 101 reason occurrences across 99 refused files.
Acceptance is compatibility with this first-line validator, not human content approval, security certification, publication permission, or proof of the complete upload/delivery workflow.
The completed full census has hash/size/verdict metadata only. Its snapshot is not a promise that Downloads contents remain unchanged after the run.
